extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism/function adjudication from primary XML/PDF, figure captions, and supplementary raw-data tables. No direct membrane-target or molecular target mechanism is claimed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Recombinant Pentatomicin shows antibacterial activity against tested Gram-positive targets Bacillus subtilis, Micrococcus luteus, and Staphylococcus aureus, with no supported finite MIC against the tested Gram-negative targets or Enterococcus spp.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is an activity-spectrum claim based on growth inhibition and MIC ranges; it is not a molecular mode-of-action assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RNAi-mediated Pentatomicin suppression increases adult Plautia stali vulnerability to Staphylococcus aureus challenge but not to Escherichia coli challenge under the tested conditions.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Pentatomicin function in adult Plautia stali
mechanism_claims.limitations: Survival data support a host-defense role against Gram-positive challenge; they do not identify a direct biochemical target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Pentatomicin expression is induced by septic shock, mock injection, and saline injection, and the paper reports partial Toll-pathway involvement with caveats that Toll may not be the sole direct regulator.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Pentatomicin expression regulation in Plautia stali
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is regulation/context evidence, not antimicrobial killing mechanism evidence.
